claims.claim: 消费者驱动的房颤识别不等于医疗发起的房颤筛查，设备识别出的房颤需要确认，因为这些筛查工具特异度各不相同，在低患病率人群中产生高假阳性率。
claims.sourceTitle: 2021 ISHNE/HRS/EHRA/APHRS Expert Collaborative Statement on mHealth in Arrhythmia Management
claims.supportQuote: consumer-driven AF identification is not the same as health care–initiated AF screening. AF identification by these devices requires confirmation, since these AF screening tools have variable specificity … raising the potential of a high false-positive rate in a low-prevalence population
claims.applicability: 直接适用于区分消费者驱动的设备提示与医疗系统发起的筛查。
claims.uncertainty: 专家协作声明（HRS/ISHNE/EHRA/APHRS），非随机证据；结论为框架性判断。

claims.claim: 设备检出房颤的敏感度与特异度取决于软件版本、所测人群（老年震颤导致更多不可读记录）与房颤患病率，不同厂商算法与软件版本的结果不能简单合并。
claims.sourceTitle: 2021 ISHNE/HRS/EHRA/APHRS Expert Collaborative Statement on mHealth in Arrhythmia Management
claims.supportQuote: Sensitivity and specificity depend on the software (which can be calibrated to higher sensitivity or higher specificity), the population studied (eg, elderly have more tremor or difficulty in holding the device, leading to more unreadable tracings), and the prevalence of AF in the population.
claims.applicability: 直接回答不同厂商算法与软件版本之间结果不可合并的原因。
claims.uncertainty: 专家声明，非定量；未给出各版本间差异的具体量值。

claims.claim: 消费级心电设备有不可判读比例，既往研究可达三分之一；Apple Watch 算法在心率低于 50 次/分或高于 150 次/分时不能评估房颤。
claims.sourceTitle: 2021 ISHNE/HRS/EHRA/APHRS Expert Collaborative Statement on mHealth in Arrhythmia Management
claims.supportQuote: in a recent study of a consumer ECG device to detect AF, a third of ECGs were unclassifiable by the device but could be classified by experts (Bumgarner 2018). … the Apple Watch is unable to assess the ECG for AF if the HR is above 150 or below 50 beats per minute
claims.applicability: 直接回答不可判读比例与算法适用心率范围。
claims.uncertainty: 三分之一不可判读引自 Bumgarner 2018 单中心研究，非跨设备汇总。

claims.claim: Apple Heart Study 纳入超过 419 000 名无房颤史参与者，0.5% 收到不规则脉搏通知（≥65 岁为 3.2%），算法对同步心电图确认房颤的阳性预测值为 0.84，但通知后佩戴贴片的 450 人中仅 34%（153/450）确认房颤。
claims.sourceTitle: 2021 ISHNE/HRS/EHRA/APHRS Expert Collaborative Statement on mHealth in Arrhythmia Management
claims.supportQuote: The study enrolled over 419 000 participants without preexisting AF … The algorithm was found to have a positive predictive value of simultaneous ECG-confirmed AF of 0.84 … Only 0.5% of the enrolled population received any irregular pulse notification, but 3.2% of those aged ≥65 years received notifications. However, only 153 of 450 (34%) patients had AF detected by subsequent single ECG patches
claims.applicability: 直接回答大型前瞻性研究中发出提示比例、确认比例与阳性预测值。
claims.uncertainty: Apple Heart Study 数值经专家声明转述，非原始论文全文；阴性预测值未估计。

claims.claim: 华为设备筛查研究约 187 000 人监测 7 个月，房颤检出 0.23%，经验证阳性预测值高于 90%（87% 经确认），对比 Apple Heart Study 的 34%。
claims.sourceTitle: 2021 ISHNE/HRS/EHRA/APHRS Expert Collaborative Statement on mHealth in Arrhythmia Management
claims.supportQuote: about 187 000 individuals monitored their pulse rhythm for 7 months. AF was found in 0.23% … Validation was achieved in 87% (positive predictive value >90%) compared with 34% in Apple Heart.
claims.applicability: 直接回答不同筛查研究的检出率与阳性预测值差异。
claims.uncertainty: 华为筛查（Guo 2019）数值经专家声明转述；阳性预测值依赖二次验证策略。

claims.claim: 欧洲与美国指南均推荐 ≥65 岁人群的机会性筛查；美国预防服务工作组对以心电图为手段的系统性筛查给出证据不足的结论。
claims.sourceTitle: 2021 ISHNE/HRS/EHRA/APHRS Expert Collaborative Statement on mHealth in Arrhythmia Management
claims.supportQuote: The European and American guidelines do recommend opportunistic screening for early identification of undiagnosed AF in patients aged ≥65 years … the US Preventative Services Task Force has presently given an insufficient recommendation for systematic screening for AF with electrocardiograms
claims.applicability: 直接回答筛查推荐及其人群边界与反对系统性筛查的立场。
claims.uncertainty: 为专家声明对各指南的归纳，具体推荐等级以各指南原文为准。

claims.claim: 以同步 Holter 为参照，PPG 算法检出房颤的敏感度为 94.2%、特异度为 96.9%，可穿戴 6 导联心电为 99.2% 与 99.1%，PPG 与心电联合为 94.2% 与 99.6%。
claims.sourceTitle: DoubleCheck-AF
claims.supportQuote: a validation study of a wrist-worn device dedicated to providing both continuous PPG-based rhythm monitoring and instant 6-lead ECG with no wires … We performed a prospective, non-randomized study of 344 participants including 121 patients in AF … 95 patients in stable SR and 128 patients in SR with frequent premature ventricular or atrial contractions (PVCs/PACs) … AF detection with PPG-based algorithm, ECG of the wearable and combination of both yielded sensitivity and specificity of 94.2 and 96.9%; 99.2 and 99.1%; 94.2 and 99.6%, respectively.
claims.applicability: 直接回答 PPG 与 6 导联心电对房颤的诊断准确性。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心、病例对照设计，白种人为主；房颤组以阵发性为主。

claims.claim: PPG 假阳性病例全部来自频发房性/室性早搏组，稳定窦性心律组未出现假阳性（P<0.001），提示早搏等心律混杂是 PPG 假阳性的主要来源。
claims.sourceTitle: DoubleCheck-AF
claims.supportQuote: All seven false-positive PPG-based cases were from the frequent PVCs/PACs group compared to none from the stable SR group ( P < 0.001).
claims.applicability: 直接回答阳性预测值随其他心律失常类型如何变化。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心研究；早搏负荷（中位 6.2 次/分）可能高于一般人群。

claims.claim: ESC 2020 指南将 ≥65 岁人群经脉搏触诊或心电节律条的机会性筛查列为 I 类推荐，将 ≥75 岁或高卒中风险人群的系统性心电筛查列为 IIa 类推荐。
claims.sourceTitle: DoubleCheck-AF
claims.supportQuote: the European Society of Cardiology upgraded the recommendation class for systematic electrocardiography (ECG) screening to detect AF in individuals aged ≥75 years, or those at high risk of stroke from 'may be considered' (class IIb) to 'should be considered' (class IIa) … Opportunistic screening for AF by pulse taking or ECG rhythm strip in patients ≥65 years of age remains 'recommended' (class I).
claims.applicability: 直接回答筛查推荐强度与人群边界。
claims.uncertainty: ESC 2020 指南推荐经研究论文转述，非指南原文；2024 版可能有更新。

claims.claim: 在门诊验证队列中，四款消费级设备对房颤的敏感度均为 100%，特异度为 96.4% 至 98.9%；不可判读（质量不足）比例为 7.4% 至 14.8%，且老年患者更常见。
claims.sourceTitle: Comparative Evaluation of Consumer Wearable Devices for Atrial Fibrillation Detection: Validation Study
claims.supportQuote: The sensitivity to detect AF was 100% for all devices. The specificity to detect sinus rhythm was 96.4% (95% CI 89.5%-98.8%) for KardiaMobile 6L, 97.8% (95% CI 91.6%‐99.5%) for Apple Watch, 98.9% (95% CI 92.5%‐99.8%) for FibriCheck, and 97.8% (95% CI 91.5%‐99.4%) for Preventicus … Insufficient quality measurements were observed in 10.7% (95% CI 6.3%-17.5%) of cases for both KardiaMobile 6L and Apple Watch, 7.4% (95% CI 3.9%‐13.6%) for FibriCheck, and 14.8% (95% CI 9.5%‐22.2%) for Preventicus
claims.applicability: 直接回答敏感度、特异度与不可判读比例。
claims.uncertainty: 不可判读记录被排除分析，可能高估准确性；白种人为主、无频发早搏。

claims.claim: 确立房颤诊断需在标准 12 导联心电图或 ≥30 秒的单导联心电图上见到不规则心律且 QRS 前无清晰 P 波。
claims.sourceTitle: INTERPRET-AF
claims.supportQuote: the diagnosis of AF should be made on a standard 12-lead ECG or a ≥30 s single-lead ECG, showing an irregularly irregular rhythm, with no discernible P-waves preceding the QRS complexes
claims.applicability: 直接回答确立诊断所需记录的种类与最短时长。
claims.uncertainty: 转述 ESC 2020 指南定义，非指南原文。

claims.claim: PPG 不能用于确立房颤诊断，即使经医师复核也不被接受；单导联心电在 ESC 2020 指南中为 I 类推荐。
claims.sourceTitle: INTERPRET-AF
claims.supportQuote: While the use of a single-lead ECG is a class I recommendation in the ESC 2020 guidelines, the use of PPG alone to establish the diagnosis is not accepted, even when overread by a physician
claims.applicability: 直接回答设备提示与临床确诊的分界。
claims.uncertainty: 指南条文转述；PPG 用于已确诊房颤的随访监控另当别论。

claims.claim: 当自动算法提示疑似房颤时，现行指南要求必须经心电图记录确认。
claims.sourceTitle: INTERPRET-AF
claims.supportQuote: Current guidelines state that when AF is suspected by an automated algorithm, confirmation on an ECG tracing is always required.
claims.applicability: 直接回答设备提示后的确认要求。
claims.uncertainty: 指南条文转述。

claims.claim: 按房颤患病率 6% 模拟，单导联心电的阳性预测值为 48.7%，原始 PPG 波形为 29.3%，12 导联心电为 81.0%，阳性预测值随患病率下降而显著下降。
claims.sourceTitle: INTERPRET-AF
claims.supportQuote: The performance was calculated in a hypothetical population with AF prevalence of 6% … The raw PPG waveform resulted in the lowest PPV (29.3%; 26.5–32.2), which increased when the plots were provided (44.7%; CI 40.1–49.5%) and when the algorithm output was provided (55.5%; CI 49.6–61.2). This is numerically comparable to single-lead ECG (48.7%; CI 43.0–54.4%), but lower than 12-lead ECG (81.0%; CI 72.4–87.4%).
claims.applicability: 直接回答阳性预测值随患病率变化及其在低危人群中的偏离程度。
claims.uncertainty: 基于医师判读的敏感度/特异度外推，非直接实测筛查队列的阳性预测值。

claims.claim: 中国队列以 24 小时 Holter 为参照验证智能手表 PPG 房颤负荷算法，敏感度 91.5%、特异度 97.2%（145 例阵发性房颤）。
claims.sourceTitle: Photoplethysmography-Based Machine Learning Approaches for Atrial Fibrillation Burden
claims.supportQuote: Participants underwent simultaneous rhythm monitoring using smartwatch PPG and 24-hour Holter electrocardiogram monitoring (the gold standard) … A total of 145 participants with paroxysmal AF … the PPG-based AF burden model demonstrated a sensitivity of 91.5% (95% CI 87.9%-95.1%), specificity of 97.2% (95% CI 95.9%-98.5%)
claims.applicability: 直接回答以 Holter 为参照标准的中国人群验证。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心前瞻性先导研究，仅阵发性房颤人群，未含频发早搏对照。

claims.sourceTitle: Estimated stroke risk, yield, and number needed to screen for atrial fibrillation (patient-level meta-analysis)
claims.supportQuote: Below age 60 years yield was 0.34%, increasing to 2.73% for ages 85 years and over. For screening people ≥65 years (as per guideline recommendations), the detection rate of new AF was 1.44% (95% CI, 1.13%–1.82%), compared with only 0.41% (95% CI, 0.31%–0.53%) for people aged <65 years (rate ratio = 3.57, 95% CI, 3.10–4.10)
claims.applicability: 直接回答筛查检出率随年龄变化，支撑阳性预测值随患病率变化的判断。
claims.uncertainty: 单时点筛查，低估阵发性房颤；纳入研究异质性高。

claims.claim: ≥65 岁筛查发现的新发房颤中 84% 有 I 类抗凝指征，<65 岁仅 26%。
claims.sourceTitle: Estimated stroke risk, yield, and number needed to screen for atrial fibrillation (patient-level meta-analysis)
claims.supportQuote: the clear majority (84%) of screen-detected new AF was eligible for OAC with a Class-1 recommendation … for those <65 years, only 26% received a Class-1 recommendation
claims.applicability: 直接回答筛查发现房颤的抗凝指征随年龄分层。
claims.uncertainty: 按 ESC 2016 指南抗凝指征计算。

claims.claim: 现有证据不支持在 <65 岁一般人群中筛查房颤：发现一个可治病例所需筛查人数升至 1,089（<60 岁）。
claims.sourceTitle: Estimated stroke risk, yield, and number needed to screen for atrial fibrillation (patient-level meta-analysis)
claims.supportQuote: the NNS-Rx rose steeply from 211 to 926, and a further increase to 1,089 for people aged <60 years … Our data do not support screening a general population younger than 65 years
claims.applicability: 直接回答筛查推荐的人群边界与低危年轻人群偏离的原因。
claims.uncertainty: 结论基于单时点筛查的检出率与抗凝指征，非结局终点。

claims.claim: 胸痛伴大汗、恶心、头晕或气短可能是心肌梗死，须立即呼救急诊（英国为 999，中国为 120）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 直接回答哪些伴随表现要求即刻急诊评估。
claims.uncertainty: 英国国家医疗服务体系患者指导；急诊号码按中国本地化为 120。

claims.claim: 在首次诊断房颤一年内启动的早期节律控制使心血管事件风险降低 21%（EAST-AFNET 4，含卒中与心力衰竭事件的减少）。
claims.sourceTitle: Estimated atrial fibrillation burden on early rhythm-control and cardiovascular events in the EAST-AFNET 4 trial
claims.supportQuote: Early-rhythm-control therapy, initiated within one year after a first diagnosis of AF, reduced the risk of cardiovascular events by 21% in the Early Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation for Stroke Prevention Trial (EAST-AFNET 4), including fewer strokes and heart failure events. … randomised 2789 adults aged over 75 years
claims.applicability: 直接回答节律控制的随机对照证据强度。
claims.uncertainty: 结论来自 2789 例新诊断、>75 岁或合并症人群，向年轻低危人群外推受限制。

claims.claim: ASSERT 研究显示植入装置检出的亚临床房颤使卒中/体循环栓塞风险增至 2.49 倍（HR 2.49，95%CI 1.28–4.85），但仅 >24 小时的发作显著预测卒中（HR 3.24，P=0.003）。
claims.sourceTitle: Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Implications of recent trials for guideline updates?
claims.supportQuote: Those with SCAF had a five-fold higher risk of developing clinical AF [hazard ratio (HR) 5.56; 95% confidence interval (CI): 3.78-8.17; P < 0.001] and a 2.5-fold higher risk of stroke or SE (HR 2.49; 95%CI: 1.28-4.85; P = 0.007 … Only episodes > 24 hours significantly predicted stroke/SE (HR 3.24; P = 0.003).
claims.applicability: 直接回答亚临床房颤发作时长与卒中风险的量效关系。
claims.uncertainty: ASSERT 数值经综述转述；监测窗仅 3 个月。

claims.claim: ARTESiA 试验（4012 例，CHA₂DS₂-VASc≥3）中阿哌沙班使卒中/体循环栓塞减少 37%（HR 0.63，95%CI 0.45–0.88），大出血从 0.94% 升至 1.71%/年（HR 1.80）。
claims.sourceTitle: Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Implications of recent trials for guideline updates?
claims.supportQuote: no episode exceeding 24 hours … Eligible patients also had a CHA 2 DS 2 -VASc score ≥ 3 … A total of 4012 patients were randomized … The primary outcome occurred in 55 patients in the apixaban group and 86 in the aspirin group (HR 0.63; 95%CI: 0.45-0.88; P = 0.007). Hence, a 37% reduction in stroke and SE was seen with apixaban therapy … The rate of major bleeding was 1.71% per patient-year with apixaban and 0.94% per patient-year with aspirin (HR 1.80; 95%CI: 1.26-2.57; P = 0.001).
claims.applicability: 直接回答亚临床房颤抗凝的获益与出血权衡。
claims.uncertainty: ARTESiA 数值经综述转述；纳入人群为植入装置检出、最长发作 <24 小时者。

claims.claim: NOAH-AFNET 6 试验（2536 例）依度沙班未显著减少主要终点（HR 0.81，95%CI 0.60–1.08），且因无效提前终止。
claims.sourceTitle: Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Implications of recent trials for guideline updates?
claims.supportQuote: The NOAH-AFNET 6 study … Of the total 2536 patients enrolled, 1270 were assigned to edoxaban and 1266 to placebo … The trial was terminated early after a median follow-up of 21 months due to safety concerns and an independent assessment indicating futility … A primary efficacy event occurred in 83 patients in the edoxaban group (3.2% per patient-year) vs 101 in the placebo group (4.0% per patient-year; HR 0.81; 95%CI: 0.60-1.08; P = 0.15)
claims.applicability: 直接回答另一项亚临床房颤抗凝试验的阴性结果。
claims.uncertainty: NOAH-AFNET 6 数值经综述转述；主要终点含心血管死亡，与 ARTESiA 不同。

claims.claim: NOAH-AFNET 6 与 ARTESiA 的合并分析显示，口服抗凝使缺血性卒中减少 32%（HR 0.68，95%CI 0.50–0.92），大出血增加 62%。
claims.sourceTitle: Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Implications of recent trials for guideline updates?
claims.supportQuote: It included > 6500 patients from the NOAH-AFNET 6 and ARTESIA trials. OAC use was associated with a 32% reduction in ischemic stroke (HR 0.68; 95%CI: 0.50-0.92) … Major bleeding events increased by 62% with OAC
claims.applicability: 直接回答亚临床房颤抗凝的净获益方向。
claims.uncertainty: 合并分析数值经综述转述，异质性低但两试验主要终点不同。

claims.claim: 2023 年 ACC/AHA 指南按发作时长与 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 分层（<6 分钟不需抗凝，6 分钟至 24 小时且 CHA₂DS₂-VASc>3 考虑抗凝，>24 小时且 CHA₂DS₂-VASc>2 考虑抗凝）；2024 年 ESC 指南仅给出 IIb 类推荐。
claims.sourceTitle: Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Implications of recent trials for guideline updates?
claims.supportQuote: The 2023 ACC/AHA guideline for AF management advocates that patients with SCAF < 6 minutes duration do not need any OAC. For patients with SCAF duration between 6 minutes to 24 hours, a CHA 2 DS 2 VASc score > 3 would indicate the need for OAC. For those with SCAF duration > 24 hours, a CHA 2 DS 2 VASc score > 2 would indicate the need for OAC. … The 2024 ESC guidelines fail to give an unequivocal recommendation … The guidelines say that DOACs can be used in patients with SCAF with high stroke risk and low bleeding risk (Class IIb recommendation).
claims.applicability: 直接回答亚临床房颤抗凝的起始阈值与推荐强度。
claims.uncertainty: 指南条文经综述转述；两指南对发作时长口径并不完全一致。

claims.claim: 亚临床房颤患者的卒中绝对风险约为 1%/年，约为临床确诊房颤的一半，因此植入装置人群的抗凝证据不能直接外推至更年轻低危的消费级设备提示人群。
claims.sourceTitle: Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Implications of recent trials for guideline updates?
claims.supportQuote: Individuals with SCAF had an absolute increase in stroke risk of approximately 1% per year-roughly half the risk observed in patients clinically diagnosed with AF
claims.applicability: 直接回答外推至消费级设备提示人群时的风险梯度差异。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述；1%/年为近似值。

claims.claim: 亚临床房颤抗凝试验中约 46% 至 56% 的患者合并血管疾病（含冠心病），合并血管病者卒中与出血事件率均更高。
claims.sourceTitle: Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Implications of recent trials for guideline updates?
claims.supportQuote: Approximately half of the patients in the two trials had pre-existing vascular disease (56% and 46%).
claims.applicability: 直接回答房颤与冠心病在人群中的并存比例。
claims.uncertainty: 为两项试验的合并构成，非一般人群房颤与冠心病的并存流行病学数据。

claims.claim: 医师对 PPG 波形判读的敏感度为 88.8%、特异度为 86.3%，附加 tachogram 与 Poincaré 图后升至 95.5% 与 92.5%；单导联心电为 91.2% 与 93.9%，12 导联心电为 93.9% 与 98.6%。
claims.sourceTitle: INTERPRET-AF
claims.supportQuote: Sixty-five physicians detected or excluded AF based on the raw PPG waveforms with 88.8% sensitivity and 86.3% specificity. Additional presentation of the tachogram plus Poincaré plot significantly increased sensitivity and specificity to 95.5% ( P < 0.001) and 92.5% ( P < 0.001), respectively. … Physicians detected AF on single-lead ECG tracings with 91.2% sensitivity and 93.9% specificity. Diagnostic accuracy was also not optimal on full 12-lead ECGs (93.9 and 98.6%, respectively).
claims.applicability: 直接回答医师判读与设备算法的相对准确性，支撑阳性预测值随患病率下降的论证。
claims.uncertainty: 调查设计，基于 30 例高质量记录的房颤/窦性/早搏分类，非真实筛查队列。
